coverage.label: Personnages
coverage.guidance: Use visible heads/upper costumes only. Garrus is explicitly named in ME3; ME2 cover identities are visual matches, not individual captions. Do not use the unlabelled ME1 cover side figures as named characters.

coverage.label: Boss
coverage.guidance: Only a tentative Saren face match is available in cover art. No encounter-specific Saren body or Benezia/Human-Reaper image was established; these remain unresolved. Do not present an invented full-body boss as a sourced reconstruction.

coverage.label: Ennemis
coverage.guidance: The manual names enemy types but does not supply a legible dedicated labelled body image in the inspected material. Names and combat tips do not establish geometry or costume. Further visual reference is required.

coverage.label: PNJ
coverage.guidance: The Joker subtitle is not proof that the visible face is Joker. No sufficiently named, readable NPC appearance was established. Keep existing prototype symbols or obtain a dedicated primary image.

coverage.label: Costumes
coverage.guidance: Retain work-specific visible armor and helmet cues. Do not combine Miranda ME2 clothing, Garrus ME3 armor and MEA N7 into one purported original suit. These references do not certify all armor pieces, rear seams or physical variants.

coverage.label: Armes
coverage.guidance: Use the four ME1 illustrations as family references only and the ME3 Vindicator as the specifically named model. No unsupported manufacturer, rank series, firing mechanism or statistics may be inferred from the artwork.

coverage.label: Mods
coverage.guidance: The sources establish upgrade families and two ME3 ports, not exact named module shapes. Any new icon must remain a declared original symbolic prototype; thermal clips must not be relabelled as learned modes or weapon mods.

coverage.label: Véhicules
coverage.guidance: Mako can follow its source image within ME1. Nomad is described in MEA text but no usable body/skin image is provided here. Do not reuse a Mako body or invent a certified Nomad livery.

coverage.label: Vaisseaux
coverage.guidance: The named hull supports SR-1 only. SR-2 interiors/text, Tempest text and an unnamed cover silhouette do not establish those exterior hulls. Sovereign and the other ships remain unqualified for exact reconstruction.
